prose.subject: Payment Required: Larchmont Facility Status Report
prose.body: Your request to access the detailed facility status report from Larchmont Facilities requires a one-time payment of 8520.11 USDC. This report includes comprehensive data on equipment uptime, energy consumption metrics, and maintenance logs for the last quarter. To proceed, send the exact amount to the wallet address 0x19da2213d9d38b0ce092bc4c8a893b36d65e64aa. Once the transaction is confirmed on the network, your report will be unlocked immediately. Please ensure you include the correct asset type (USDC) to avoid processing delays. If you have questions about the specific sections covered in this dataset, refer to the API documentation linked in the previous response. This payment covers full access to the structured JSON output as well as a downloadable PDF summary. No subscription fees apply for this single lookup. The data is current as of the last server sync. Thank you for choosing Larchmont Facilities for your operational insights.
